description: Fervent Healing and Gods' Whip each retain their exact four one-second combo transitions.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill_effects se JOIN effects e ON e.id = se.effect_id JOIN special_effects special ON special.id = e.actual_id WHERE e.actual_type = 'SpecialEffect' AND special.special_effect_type_id = 48 AND special.value2 = 1000 AND ((se.skill_id = 14929 AND special.value1 = 14930) OR (se.skill_id = 14930 AND special.value1 = 14931) OR (se.skill_id = 14931 AND special.value1 = 14932) OR (se.skill_id = 14932 AND special.value1 = 14933) OR (se.skill_id = 23593 AND special.value1 = 23646) OR (se.skill_id = 23646 AND special.value1 = 23647) OR (se.skill_id = 23647 AND special.value1 = 23648) OR (se.skill_id = 23648 AND special.value1 = 23649));
